description: This source file defines a Java interface 'QueryCommandAdapterProvider' within a protocol adapter package, specifying methods to retrieve adapters for query commands and responses related to signals and command responses.

classes.name: QueryCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: Generic interface for providing adapters for query commands and responses, parametrized with types of signals and command responses.

methods.name: getQueryCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns an Adapter for the query command type Q.

methods.name: getQueryCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns an Adapter for the query command response type R.
